small_e2e.decision: keep MLX grouped SDPA as the default

dq_gemm_sweep.decision: keep the measured 768-row crossover; retain TURBOCIDER_VDN_DQ_GEMM_MIN_ROWS for explicit local sweeps

compact_linear_output.scope: allocate only the leading global/anchor rows and trailing anchor frame instead of a full zero sequence
compact_linear_output.decision: memory-only experiment; default disabled because the single run was slower

window_index_cache.scope: cache fixed MLX query/key index tensors for the 50-block, six-step window-softmax geometry
window_index_cache.geometry: 384x384x22, six steps, eight zero text rows, seed 42
window_index_cache.decision: keep the cache for deterministic geometry reuse and lower host allocation churn; do not claim a material GPU speedup

rejected_ltx_qkv_experiment.scope: runtime concatenation of packed ConvRot affine-Q8 Q/K/V rows
rejected_ltx_qkv_experiment.decision: removed; performance observations are invalid because parity failed

conclusion.reason: The window-index cache is exactly parity-safe but its strict A/B median effect is negligible. MMA attention, compact output, and alternate DQ-GEMM floors either lost wall time or reduced memory only. The existing MLX grouped-SDPA and 768-row DQ-GEMM crossover remain the fastest qualified choices in this matrix.
conclusion.remaining_gate: matched 960x544x124 TurboCider versus vpipe ABBA and full quality panel
